description: Accumulated undocumented items from previous crews had unknown provenance and no disposal record. Commander Cinelli (Crew 16) described surprise at the number of items and the effort required to sort them.
response: Crew 16 spent significant rainy-day time cataloguing the items and began a formal electronic inventory.
lesson: Request Crew 16's electronic inventory from the Mars Society before departure. Every crew must make a leave/discard/return decision for every item at mission close and document it.
